name: Evil Eel 92
author: ercnersoy
description: Neon rounded green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ccc to #72eb67, transform becomes translateX(2.2em), background-color changes from #ccc to #008000. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #2196f3.
